gaps.explanation: Nothing missing. The Bond proceeds 545,000 are in detail[] (Schedule 2 p11, Debt Service Fund, other financing). The schedule_total -51,827 also counts the two other rows the report prints in the same Other financing sources (uses) section of the Debt Service column: Bond principal paid (570,000) and Bond interest and fees paid/refunded (26,827) (p6 Exhibit E Totals 2022: 545,000 / (570,000) / (26,827); p11 same). The JSON statement keeps those two in other_financing (-596,827), not in debt_proceeds. 545,000 - 570,000 - 26,827 = -51,827 = detail, so debt_proceeds + other_financing tie exactly with the schedule; the gap is only the split of the printed section. No fix.
